title: A harmless prompt passes the inspector
goal: For {{castBrand}}, {{castApp}} keeps working while it is {{castTask}}, with an inspector on {{castKey}}.
obstacle: The key has an external inspector, and a clean request must not be slowed down or turned away by it.
control: The gateway inspects the prompt on the way in and the answer on the way out. Neither has a finding, the client gets the answer, and the trace shows the three steps with their lab time.
